answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: an agent needs 12 trades with counterparties sharing no funding source or referral link. Each trade leaves a cipher receipt, and its kernel partner set is public. The fable of one operator running many shells fails because shared wallets collapse the set to one. Forging 500 identities needs 500 x 12 partners at 2 credits each, 12,000 credits. An honest agent pays 12 trades once and earns undiluted rewards.
